items.title: Strong-RRQR interpolative decomposition with explicit statuses
items.statement: Define the exact-arithmetic rank-k column ID from a successful strong-RRQR factorization, with T(:,J)=I, k=0 and k=n branches, and explicit rank-loss, budget, and finite-precision certificate statuses.

items.title: The Moore-Penrose products are orthogonal projectors
items.statement: For every finite matrix M, MM† and M†M are self-adjoint idempotents; MM† projects onto Ran(M), and full row rank implies MM†=I.

items.title: Skeleton and projected least-squares CUR cores
items.statement: For selected columns C=A(:,J), rows R=A(I,:), and cross W=A(I,J), define the skeleton core W† and the distinct projected least-squares core C†AR†, identifying the corresponding reconstructions.

items.title: The positive-semidefinite Nyström approximation
items.statement: For Hermitian positive-semidefinite A and any conformal sketch S, define the Nyström core S*AS and approximation AS(S*AS)†S*A, with explicit finite matrix dimensions.

items.title: Strong-RRQR interpolative decomposition error and coefficient bounds
items.statement: On exact-arithmetic success, the selected-column ID has identity interpolation columns, coefficient modulus at most f, and residual norm equal to ||R22||2 and at most sqrt(1+f^2 k(n-k))*sigma_(k+1)(A); handle k=0 and k=n separately.

items.title: Skeleton CUR is exact for a full-rank cross
items.statement: If the selected cross W is k-by-k and rank(A)=rank(W)=k, the skeleton reconstruction C W† R equals A, including the rank-zero branch.

items.title: Projected CUR has a two-sided Frobenius residual bound
items.statement: For the projected least-squares CUR core C†AR†, its residual is bounded by ||(I-P_C)A||F+||A(I-P_R)||F, where P_C=CC† and P_R=R†R; this conclusion is not assigned to the skeleton W† core.

items.title: Nyström is a square-root orthogonal-projection compression
items.statement: For B=A^(1/2)S, the Nyström approximation equals A^(1/2)P_Ran(B)A^(1/2), with P_Ran(B)=B(B*B)†B*=BB†.

items.title: Nyström is positive semidefinite, dominated by A, and exact when it captures the range
items.statement: For every PSD A and sketch S, 0<=Ahat<=A; if Ran(AS)=Ran(A), then Ahat=A.

items.title: Nyström deterministic spectral residual bound under a full-row-rank leading sketch
items.statement: Partition A's eigenvalues at k and write Ω1=U1*S, Ω2=U2*S. If Ω1 has full row rank, ||A-Ahat||2 <= λ_(k+1)+||Λ2^(1/2)Ω2Ω1†||2^2, with the empty-tail convention.

title: Interpolative cur and nystrom decompositions — Examples

items.title: A prescribed column can miss the dominant direction
items.statement: Refute a uniform rank-k ID error guarantee for every prescribed column set by A=diag(10,1), k=1, and J={2}; every interpolant with T(:,J)=1 has residual norm at least 10 although sigma_2(A)=1.

items.title: An exact rank-two CUR reconstruction from a nonsingular cross
items.statement: For the displayed rank-two 3-by-3 matrix and its leading 2-by-2 cross, compute C, W, R and verify C W† R=A.

items.title: A PSD Nyström residual remains positive semidefinite
items.statement: For A=diag(4,1) and S=e1, compute Ahat=diag(4,0) and A-Ahat=diag(0,1), confirming the general PSD-order theorem.
